subcases.qualification_boundary: Continuity observation only; eligibility/rank correctness requires exact evidence-chain review against the Minimum Opportunity Evidence Gate.

derived_regression_requirements: Cloud-sensitive source loss must not erase unrelated valid evidence.
Missing evidence must not be represented as current or silently inferred.
Opportunity continuity may persist only when upstream governance still permits it.
If current evidence falls below the Minimum Opportunity Evidence Gate, ranked delivery must cease.
Stale/latest-available evidence must retain age and provenance.
Degraded observing conditions must not collapse independent evidence channels into a shared unavailable state.
Severe-weather validation is evidence-governance validation, not safety certification.
follow_up_required: Review exact evidence chains for ranked Opportunity #1 and #2 at the captured cycle.
Identify cloud-sensitive missing/stale/degraded evidence for each Opportunity.
Verify any fallback evidence and its freshness/provenance rule.
Confirm Minimum Opportunity Evidence Gate remained satisfied using only admissible current evidence.
Confirm rank persistence was governed rather than simply carried forward.
